source_message.text: The new contract is for $850, with milestones organized by scene. I’ve also uploaded a revised script to the shared google folder; it has only a few small changes from the previous version. Since you don’t need to create the text cards, I’ll handle those myself. That may leave a little extra in funds for fine-tuning, although we’ll have to see how things go. Please let me know if anything is unclear. Thanks!
